properties.name: springperf.batch.window-millis
properties.description: Accumulation window in milliseconds applied to every @BatchMapping that keeps the annotation default; 0 disables the window globally.

properties.name: springperf.batch.max-batch-size
properties.description: Max requests per batch applied to every @BatchMapping that keeps the annotation default.

properties.name: springperf.batch.consumer-size
properties.description: bizExecutor concurrency cap applied to every @BatchMapping that keeps the annotation default; -1 means CPU cores.

properties.name: springperf.batch.ring-buffer-size
properties.description: Ring buffer capacity applied to every @BatchMapping that keeps the annotation default; values that are not a power of two are normalised with a warning.

properties.name: springperf.batch.wait-strategy
properties.description: Disruptor wait strategy applied to every @BatchMapping that keeps the annotation default; case-insensitive, hyphens allowed (e.g. busy-spin).

properties.name: springperf.batch.backpressure
properties.description: Backpressure strategy applied to every @BatchMapping that keeps the annotation default; case-insensitive.
